# Eden Docs

> Documentation for Eden Observability — tracing, auto-instrumentation, evals, and governance for AI agents.

Primary product site: https://edenobservability.com/ (see also https://edenobservability.com/llms.txt).

## Start here

- [Docs home](https://docs.edenobservability.com/): Documentation overview
- [Quickstart](https://docs.edenobservability.com/quickstart): Signup to first trace in minutes
- [Deploy](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/deploy): Connect your app to api.edenobservability.com
- [Auto-instrument](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auto-instrument): Instrument an existing Python or TypeScript repo
- [Security model](https://docs.edenobservability.com/explanation/security-model): Tenant isolation, PII redaction, audit defaults

## How-to

- [How-to index](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/): Task-oriented guides
- [Auth](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/auth): Authentication
- [API keys](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/api-keys): Create and manage API keys
- [Connect any agent](https://docs.edenobservability.com/how-to/connect-any-agent): Integration patterns for agents

## Reference & explanation

- [Reference index](https://docs.edenobservability.com/reference/): SDKs, API, and configuration
- [Explanation index](https://docs.edenobservability.com/explanation/): Architecture and design deep dives
- [Tutorials](https://docs.edenobservability.com/tutorials/): Hands-on learning paths

- [Docs sitemap](https://docs.edenobservability.com/sitemap.xml): Full docs URL list
